behaviors.behavior: read_manifest_version returns the top-level version for a well-formed marketplace_json manifest
rejects a marketplace_json manifest with no plugins key, or plugins that isn't a list, or a plugins[] entry that isn't an object
still requires the top-level version field for marketplace_json; accepts an empty plugins list
render_manifest_write bumps root + every plugins[].version via the byte-preserving surgical path when all entries are in lockstep
self-heals (full JSON re-render) when a plugins[] entry has already drifted from current_version
round-trip: a written marketplace_json reads back consistently (root + every plugin entry)
sync() orchestrates one package_json + one marketplace_json entry declared together in one config
sync() still writes (self-heals) a manifest whose root already matches the target but has a stale nested plugins[] entry, instead of wrongly skipping it as already-current
verify_commit reads a marketplace_json's COMMITTED blob correctly (root + nested) and passes
verify_commit fails (verify_mismatch) when the committed blob's root matches but a nested plugins[] entry is stale
the standing drift check (check_manifest_version_matches_tag) passes for a fully in-lockstep marketplace_json manifest
the standing drift check warns when a marketplace_json's root matches the tag but a nested plugins[] entry is stale

this monorepo's own shipwright_changelog_config.json declares exactly the 14 real plugins/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json files on disk, and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json with the marketplace_json format
this monorepo's own new config resolves against the real files end-to-end (empirical, not fixture)
